fidelity_issues.message: MODULE004 wall-limit reach and post metric are constructive approximations on the existing coarse house scale, not photo measurements.
The terminal closure topology is supported, but its exact angle is not observable; the orthogonal LEGO closure is constructive only.
Only the observed main support is represented. Hidden additional supports remain unknown and are not promoted to photographic truth.
Diagonal braces are observed but remain unimplemented because the current orthogonal engine lacks an honest diagonal beam primitive.
